question:
For six different cities of Gujarat State, the approximate figures regarding their density of population (per square km) and the death rate (per thousand) are given below.

| City | A | B | C | D | E | F |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Density (per sq.km) x | 200 | 500 | 400 | 700 | 600 | 300 |
| Death rate (per thousand) y | 10 | 12 | 10 | 15 | 9 | 12 |

Find the correlation coefficient between the density of population and death rate from this information.
question_hi:
गुजरात राज्य के छह अलग-अलग शहरों के लिए, उनकी जनसंख्या घनत्व (प्रति वर्ग किमी) और मृत्यु दर (प्रति हजार) के बारे में अनुमानित आंकड़े नीचे दिए गए हैं।

| शहर | A | B | C | D | E | F |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| घनत्व (प्रति वर्ग किमी) x | 200 | 500 | 400 | 700 | 600 | 300 |
| मृत्यु दर (प्रति हजार) y | 10 | 12 | 10 | 15 | 9 | 12 |

इस जानकारी से जनसंख्या घनत्व और मृत्यु दर के बीच सहसंबंध गुणांक ज्ञात कीजिए।
question_gu:
ગુજરાત રાજ્યના છ જુદા જુદા શહેરો માટે, તેમની વસ્તીની ઘનતા (ચોરસ કિમી દીઠ) અને મૃત્યુ દર (હજાર દીઠ) અંગેના અંદાજિત આંકડા નીચે આપેલા છે.

| શહેર | A | B | C | D | E | F |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ઘનતા (ચોરસ કિમી દીઠ) x | 200 | 500 | 400 | 700 | 600 | 300 |
| મૃત્યુ દર (હજાર દીઠ) y | 10 | 12 | 10 | 15 | 9 | 12 |

આ માહિતી પરથી વસ્તીની ઘનતા અને મૃત્યુ દર વચ્ચેનો સહસંબંધાંક શોધો.
solution:
Here, n=6, x̄ = 2700/6 = 450, ȳ = 68/6 = 11.33

We can also see that the values of X are in multiple of 100 and the values of Y are small. So, we shall take A = 500, B = 12, cx = 100 and cy = 1

Let us define new variables u and v as follows:
u = (x - A)/cx = (x - 500)/100
v = (y - B)/cy = (y - 12)/1

| Density (x) | Death rate (y) | u | v | uv | u² | v² |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 200 | 10 | -3 | -2 | 6 | 9 | 4 |
| 500 | 12 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| 400 | 10 | -1 | -2 | 2 | 1 | 4 |
| 700 | 15 | 2 | 3 | 6 | 4 | 9 |
| 600 | 9 | 1 | -3 | -3 | 1 | 9 |
| 300 | 12 | -2 | 0 | 0 | 4 | 0 |
| Total: 2700 | Total: 68 | Total: -3 | Total: -4 | Total: 11 | Total: 19 | Total: 26 |

r = (nΣuv - (Σu)(Σv)) / √([nΣu² - (Σu)²][nΣv² - (Σv)²])
r = (6(11) - (-3)(-4)) / √([6(19) - (-3)²][6(26) - (-4)²])
r = (66 - 12) / √([114 - 9][156 - 16])
r = 54 / √(105 × 140)
r = 54 / √14700
r = 54 / 121.24
r = 0.45

We can see that the value of r is not very close to 1. Thus, there is a moderate degree of positive correlation between density of population and death rate.

question:
In order to study the relation between the sales (in crore ₹) and the profit (in thousand ₹) for truck tyre manufacturing companies, the following information is obtained for the last year.

| Sales (crore ₹) x | 1.6 | 2.2 | 1.9 | 2.0 | 2.3 | 1.7 | 2.4 | 1.8 | 2.1 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Profit (thousand ₹) y | 4200 | 5500 | 6000 | 6200 | 6100 | 4900 | 5900 | 5000 | 6700 |

Find the correlation coefficient between the sales and the profit from it.
solution:
Here, n=9, x̄ = 18/9 = 2, and ȳ = 50500/9 = 5611.11

Since the values of variable X are fractional and having one digit after decimal point, we shall multiply the values of X by 10 (i.e. divide by cx = 0.1) to make them integer and the values of Y are multiples of 100, we shall take A = 2, B = 5600, cx = 0.1, cy = 100

Let us now define variables u and v as follows.
u = (x - A)/cx = (x - 2.0)/0.1 = 10(x - 2.0)
v = (y - B)/cy = (y - 5600)/100

| Sales (x) | Profit (y) | u | v | uv | u² | v² |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1.6 | 4200 | -4 | -14 | 56 | 16 | 196 |
| 2.2 | 5500 | 2 | -1 | -2 | 4 | 1 |
| 1.9 | 6000 | -1 | 4 | -4 | 1 | 16 |
| 2.0 | 6200 | 0 | 6 | 0 | 0 | 36 |
| 2.3 | 6100 | 3 | 5 | 15 | 9 | 25 |
| 1.7 | 4900 | -3 | -7 | 21 | 9 | 49 |
| 2.4 | 5900 | 4 | 3 | 12 | 16 | 9 |
| 1.8 | 5000 | -2 | -6 | 12 | 4 | 36 |
| 2.1 | 6700 | 1 | 11 | 11 | 1 | 121 |
| Total: 18 | Total: 50500 | Total: 0 | Total: 1 | Total: 121 | Total: 60 | Total: 489 |

r = (nΣuv - (Σu)(Σv)) / √([nΣu² - (Σu)²][nΣv² - (Σv)²])
r = (9(121) - (0)(1)) / √([9(60) - (0)²][9(489) - (1)²])
r = 1089 / √(540 × 4400)
r = 1089 / √2376000
r = 1089 / 1541.4279
r = 0.7065
r = 0.71

We can see that the value of r is slightly far from 1. So, we can say that there is a moderately high degree of positive correlation between the sales and the profit.

question:
To study the relationship between the marks obtained in Statistics (X) and marks in Economics (Y) of the students of a school, a sample of ten students is taken and the following information is obtained.

Σ(x-x̄)(y-ȳ) = 120, Σ(x-x̄)² = 80, Σ(y-ȳ)² = 500

Find the value of r.
question_hi:
एक स्कूल के छात्रों के सांख्यिकी (X) में प्राप्त अंकों और अर्थशास्त्र (Y) में अंकों के बीच संबंध का अध्ययन करने के लिए, दस छात्रों का एक नमूना लिया जाता है और निम्नलिखित जानकारी प्राप्त की जाती है।

Σ(x-x̄)(y-ȳ) = 120, Σ(x-x̄)² = 80, Σ(y-ȳ)² = 500

r का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
question_gu:
એક શાળાના વિદ્યાર્થીઓના આંકડાશાસ્ત્ર (X) માં મેળવેલ ગુણ અને અર્થશાસ્ત્ર (Y) માં મેળવેલ ગુણ વચ્ચેના સંબંધનો અભ્યાસ કરવા માટે, દસ વિદ્યાર્થીઓનો એક નિદર્શ લેવામાં આવે છે અને નીચેની માહિતી મેળવવામાં આવે છે.

Σ(x-x̄)(y-ȳ) = 120, Σ(x-x̄)² = 80, Σ(y-ȳ)² = 500

r ની કિંમત શોધો.
solution:
Here, n = 10 and the following formula is suitable to the given data.

r = Σ(x-x̄)(y-ȳ) / √[Σ(x-x̄)² × Σ(y-ȳ)²]

r = 120 / √(80 × 500)
r = 120 / √40000
r = 120 / 200
r = 0.6
